instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: A 19-year-old client with sickle cell disease develops new cough, dyspnea, tachypnea, and right-sided crackles. SpO₂ is 91% on room air, and the chest radiograph shows a new right-lower-lobe infiltrate. The client is alert without recent sedative exposure, jugular venous distention, or peripheral edema. Orders are available for an IV cephalosporin, an oral macrolide, supplemental oxygen, and respiratory care. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.
